title: Review Backlog Restart
user: Spaced-repetition users returning after a break who need an honest, manageable restart plan that protects high-risk material without forcing an all-night catch-up session.
smallest_useful_product: Local companion that imports an Anki CSV export, asks for daily minutes and deadline, simulates three recovery plans, flags highest-risk cards, and exports a tagged action list.
success_measure: At least 50% of users with a 100+ card backlog follow a plan for seven days and reduce due cards by 30% without resetting the collection.
